full_prompt_en: A square old-master style painted study isolates the head of a strange red-feathered bird against warm aged parchment. The creature faces left in extreme close-up. A long, heavy black beak curves downward into a sharp hook near the lower left corner. Above it, the pale bone-colored front of the head opens around a large dark hollow where an eye would be, exposing irregular bony rims and smaller cavities. Dense russet and vermilion feathers sweep backward from the skull and fill the upper right and right edge, their directional barbs rendered in short, precise strokes. Darker brown down appears beneath the bony hinge and along the lower neck. The left half of the background is ochre paper, marked with faded floral and circular pen-like diagrams. These fine sketches remain faint, allowing the strong profile to dominate. No body or surrounding scene is shown; the crop emphasizes the unusual junction of bone, beak, and vivid plumage. Warm illumination from the upper left catches the rounded skull and the raised feather edges, while the eye hollow and underside of the beak fall into deep gray-black shade. The surface combines smooth tonal glazing on bone and beak with dry, linear detail in the feathers and background marks. Fine cracks and worn pigment make the image feel antique. The restricted palette of parchment gold, bone cream, black, rust red, and umber intensifies the sinister profile without adding gore. The composition is starkly asymmetrical, pushing the face toward the left while the fan of feathers anchors the right. It reads as a meticulous, uncanny natural-history fantasy painting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典绘画习作把一颗奇异红羽鸟的头孤立在温暖旧羊皮纸前。生物以极近距离朝左侧身。又长又重的黑喙向下弯，在左下角附近形成尖钩。其上，浅骨色头前部围着原本眼睛的位置敞成一个巨大深洞，露出不规则骨缘与较小孔洞。密集铁锈红和朱红羽毛从头骨向后扫去，填满右上与右缘，顺向羽枝以短而精确的笔触描绘。较深棕色绒羽出现在骨性关节下和颈部下缘。左半背景是赭黄纸面，有褪色花形与圆形的钢笔式图示。这些细线草图保持微弱，让强烈侧影占主导。身体和周围场景均未展示；裁切强调骨骼、喙与鲜明羽毛的奇异连接。来自左上的暖光照亮圆润头骨与隆起羽缘，眼洞及喙底则沉入深灰黑。表面结合骨与喙的平滑罩染明暗、羽毛和背景痕迹中的干燥线性细节。细裂纹与磨旧颜料使图像有古旧感。羊皮纸金、骨白、黑、锈红与深褐的有限色域强化阴森侧影，却没有血腥。构图鲜明不对称，面部推向左侧，羽毛扇面固定右边。它像一幅细致而怪诞的自然史幻想绘画。
style_prompt_en: An antique painted study places a dramatic dark curve and pale hollowed form against warm parchment. Bone cream, ink black, rust red, and umber remain tightly controlled, with one vivid textured mass balancing a broad quiet ground. Smooth glazing shapes hard rounded planes, while short directional strokes articulate feathery or fibrous surfaces. Faint diagrammatic linework and worn cracks sit beneath the main image without distracting from its profile. Upper-side light picks out raised edges and leaves deep cavities nearly black. The close crop makes a single asymmetrical silhouette monumental. The mood is meticulous, archaic, and uncanny, with precise naturalistic detail applied to an improbable form.
style_prompt_zh: 古旧绘画习作把戏剧性深色曲线和浅色中空形体置于温暖羊皮纸前。骨白、墨黑、锈红和深褐受到严格控制，一团鲜艳有纹理的形体平衡宽阔安静底面。平滑罩染塑造坚硬圆润平面，短顺向笔触表现羽状或纤维表面。淡淡图解线痕与磨旧裂纹位于主图之下，不分散对侧影的注意。偏上侧光挑亮隆起边缘，让深腔几乎全黑。紧密裁切使单一不对称剪影显得宏大。氛围细致、古拙且怪诞，以精确自然写实细节描绘不可思议的形体。
theme_en: A red-feathered birdlike skull with a great black hooked beak fills an aged parchment ground
theme_zh: 一颗红羽鸟形头骨与巨大黑色钩喙占满旧羊皮纸背景
name: Matthias Grunewald
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
